text:
oncall-jordi: deploy-bot proposes auto-revert for embeddings due to p95 spike. I'm holding auto-revert — legal change window for this release still open (~6h). We should decide targeted routing vs full rollback.

deploy-bot: SUGGESTED ACTION: AUTO-ROLLBACK -> v3.1. metric=embeddings_p95 threshold=800ms current=1250ms windows=3.

alex: Is error-rate also up or just latency? If only latency, a routing scolldown to fallback could avoid a heavy rollback.

sre_jen: Agree. Manual rollback risky after last week's DB migration. Suggest route 10% to fallback for 10-15m and evaluate.

oncall-jordi: I can patch routing now. Alex, can you provide the patch snippet?

alex: Use: `kubectl patch configmap routing --patch '{"data":{"embeddings_route":"fallback-v1:10%"}}'`

ops-bot: routing change initiated by oncall-jordi, id=req-1a2b.

sre_jen: Seeing p95 drop in first minute. If <850ms after two windows, step to 30%.

maya: I'll draft a short note for dedicated customers (they're pinned) and post to #customer-success once we hit 30%. Created ticket INF-12456.

deploy-bot: Monitor: embeddings_p95=980ms (window1). Auto-rollback suppressed by operator hold.

oncall-jordi: Escalation plan: if p95 >=1000ms after 15m AND error_rate >1%, then manual rollback to v3.1. Otherwise continue routing up to 1h then revert.

alex: Manual rollback command if needed: `redwoodctl rollout revert --service embeddings --to-version v3.1 --reason "p95 regression" --force`

ops-bot: routing change completed. metrics remain under observation.

sre_jen: Copy. I'll watch traces and slow-logs for any correlated errors.

oncall-jordi: I'll post brief status every 5m. Ping me to take handoff. :thumbsup:
